name: zclass_world_set_partition_inclusion_tolerance
description: zClass_World::gwWorldSetPartitionInclusionTolerance stores the X/Z inclusion tolerances used by world area partitioning.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass with the partition and grid setup helpers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450f00 validates the leaf world-data access through node->classData, raw storage of the two stack float arguments into partitionInclusionTolX and partitionInclusionTolZ, return 0, and no direct callees.
The native smoke verifies both X and Z partition inclusion tolerance fields are stored.
